The '''Blood Boiler''' was a device that made use of [[Bioengineering/Legends|genetically engineered]] [[Poison/Legends|poison]] and developed by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Drugindi]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. This weapon was being developed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] which introduced the poison within the veins of a target that led to their [[Blood/Legends|blood]] turning into [[Acid/Legends|acid]], making it an incredibly painful experience for any victim.

In this era, it was nearing the point where it was able to be mass-produced, though still required a live fire testing. Thus, Doctor Drugindi tasked a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] official with testing the weapon on the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
